Blue whale:

Travel with a mother blue whale and her baby from the icy sea to the warm sea: eat krill, go up to breathe, dodge ships and protect the baby.

Screen:

★★★

Whale guardian!

The biggest animal in all of history: up to 100 feet long.
It eats krill: teeny tiny shrimp, tons every day!
Its song travels hundreds of miles through the sea.

Ships and ocean noise are its biggest danger. Let's take care of the ocean!

Real blue whale song: NOAA recordings (public domain, Wikimedia Commons, sped up so you can hear it). Orcas: NOAA (public domain). Realistic images made with AI.
